mapper.select: SELECT equipment_status AS code,COUNT(*) AS count FROM eq_equipment GROUP BY equipment_status

SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderTotal, COALESCE(SUM(w.status IN ('WAITING','PROCESSING','PENDING_REVIEW')),0) AS openOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(w.status='CLOSED'),0) AS closedOrderCount, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN w.status='CLOSED' THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,w.create_time,w.closed_time)/3600.0 END),2) AS averageClosedHours FROM eq_work_order w WHERE 1=1
SELECT w.status AS code,COUNT(*) AS count FROM eq_work_order w WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY w.status
SELECT w.fault_category AS code,COUNT(*) AS count FROM eq_work_order w WHERE w.status!='CANCELLED' GROUP BY w.fault_category ORDER BY count DESC,w.fault_category

SELECT e.equipment_id AS equipmentId,e.equipment_code AS equipmentCode,e.equipment_name AS equipmentName,COUNT(*) AS count FROM eq_work_order w JOIN eq_equipment e ON e.equipment_id=w.equipment_id WHERE w.status!='CANCELLED' GROUP BY e.equipment_id,e.equipment_code,e.equipment_name ORDER BY count DESC,e.equipment_code LIMIT 10
